ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

test_modes.name: Frame capture / decode
test_modes.purpose: Capture the single-wire pulse train and decode nibbles for bring-up.

test_modes.name: Tick-time / calibration test
test_modes.purpose: Verify the receiver recovers the tick time from the 56-tick calibration pulse across the tolerance range.

test_modes.name: CRC error injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject CRC errors to confirm detection.

test_modes.name: SPC trigger test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the SENT-SPC master trigger pulse and channel selection.

spec_provided_observability.name: CRC-4 nibble
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-frame integrity check over the data nibbles; mismatch flags a corrupted frame.

spec_provided_observability.name: Calibration-pulse measurement
spec_provided_observability.purpose: A pulse not near 56 ticks indicates loss of frame synchronization.

spec_provided_observability.name: Nibble-period range check
spec_provided_observability.purpose: A measured period outside 12-27 ticks indicates a framing error.

spec_provided_observability.name: Status nibble
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Carries 2 status bits observable each frame.

spec_provided_observability.name: Slow serial message
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Short/Enhanced serial message carries IDs and diagnostic codes over many frames.

error_detection_mechanisms: 4-bit CRC (CRC-4) nibble over the data nibbles detects frame corruption.
Out-of-range nibble period (outside 12-27 ticks) detects framing errors.
Calibration pulse not near 56 ticks detects loss of synchronization.
ECU plausibility checks across successive frames detect implausible value changes.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A complete valid frame decoded (CRC pass).
A Short/Enhanced serial message fully assembled.

notes: SENT's protocol-level observability is the per-frame CRC-4 nibble, the calibration-pulse and nibble-period range checks, the status nibble, and the slow serial message. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain sensor/SoC-integrator concerns.
